title: fix(mcp): delete_record treats a request naming one matching record as the approval
body:
Fixes #34340

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #34456 — skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md (the delete_record row of the MCP tools table still says "ask the human first, then retry")

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP `delete_record` 工具说明和它的 `confirm` 参数说明现在明写:用户点名要删的记录且恰好匹配一条,这句请求就是确认,agent 直接带 `confirm: true` 删(进回收站);名字匹配多条或没指明哪一条,先列候选问用户,答复后才带 `confirm: true`。
- 为什么改:落实裁决「点名单条就算确认」;旧文案"先问人再重试"让各模型对点名单删读法不一,评测里 121 次失败写操作有 76 次卡在这条冲突上。
- 风险与回滚:只改工具说明文字,门禁不动(不带 `confirm: true` 仍被拒,428 `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`),批量 `delete_records` 不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `delete_record` 注册段(两句新文案,描述与 `confirm` 共用);`packages/mcp/src/mcp-delete-record-confirmation.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-delete-record-confirmation.test.ts`,预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The `delete_record` tool description and its `confirm` member's description now carry two sentences, defined once beside the tool's registration and used on both:

- "A request in which the human names the record to delete, with exactly one record matching, is the human's approval of that delete: send confirm: true on that call, without asking again."
- "When the name matches more than one record, or the request does not identify one record, do not delete yet: list the candidates, ask the human which one, and send confirm: true only after the answer."

The description drops "ask the human first, then retry" and keeps everything else: the gate sentence ("A call is REFUSED unless it also sends confirm: true; nothing is deleted on a refused call."), the recycle-bin fact and the `recycleBinEntryId` sentence. The `confirm` member keeps its opening and closing sentences around the two new ones.

Unchanged: the gate itself (`recordDeleteConfirmationRefusal`, its code, status, details and message), and `delete_records` (bulk), which stays preview first with `confirm: true` only after the human approves the preview.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-delete-record-confirmation.test.ts` is the existing harness for this tool, so the pin is a new top-level `describe` there, not a new file:

- positive: both sentences, verbatim, on the tool description AND on the `confirm` member as `tools/list` serves them; the description still states the refusal and the recycle bin;
- control: `delete_records`' description and `confirm` member carry neither sentence, and still say `preview`;
- gate control (existing, unchanged): "refuses a call without the member: code, status and the retry details; the record is intact" and "refuses %s as the member" pin `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` / 428 and that the engine's `delete` is never called.

One existing assertion comment in the first describe was reworded (it described the old "ask, then retry" order); the assertion itself is unchanged.

Ablation (one-time, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, no permanent file): replacing the named-record sentence on the `confirm` member with a marker turned the new pin red (`1 failed | 10 passed`, "expected 'Set to true only when the human in th…' to contain 'A request in which the human names th…'"); the tool restored the file to the HEAD blob (`b7318758fc10`, `git diff HEAD` empty), and the full package run after it is green. A first attempt was refused by the tool before running (its replacement text already occurred 13 times in the file, so its count could not rise by one) and restored; it measured nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` line 202 is not edited here: implementation-card file surfaces exclude `skills/**`, which gets its own `domain:skills` card (and `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates a higher model tier for that path). The follow-up is #34456.
- Other readers of the old wording, left as they are (no gate demands a change, and each is outside this card's file surface): the MCP-served skill text in `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` (the `delete_record` bullet says "Ask your human first", and the gotchas and workflow sections say to confirm destructive actions such as `delete_record` with the user); `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` (the `delete_record` bullet: "The agent asks its human, then retries"); and the gate's own refusal message ("confirm with the human in the loop, then retry"), which a call reaches only without `confirm: true`. Each now reads differently from the tool text; the seat decides where they go.
- `CHANGELOG.md` entries that quote the old description are release-owned and stay.
